content: The individual responsible for airway management ensures the maintenance of a clear and functional airway for the patient during trauma care. The X-ray technician is tasked with performing radiographic imaging as instructed by the team leader. This individual typically remains at a distance from the patient and the trauma team, except when their presence is required to carry out X-ray procedures. The laboratory technician has specific responsibilities, including assisting with phlebotomy procedures and ensuring the proper transportation and processing of biological specimens. The Guidelines for Essential Trauma Care were developed with contributions from a detailed list of individuals and groups. The editors of the guidelines include Dr. Charles Mock, Dr. Jean-Dominique Lormand, Dr. Jacques Goosen, Dr. Manjul Joshipura, and Dr. Margie Peden. Contributors to the written material for the guidelines include Dr. Carlos Arreola-Risa, Dr. Mark Davis, Dr. Jacques Goosen, Dr. Manjul Joshipura, Dr. Charles Mock, Dr. Margie Peden, Dr. Robert Quansah, and Dr. Eduardo Romero Hicks. Critical readers of the guidelines, who were not involved as editors or contributors to the written material, include Dr. Patrick Amo-Mensah (Ghana), Dr. Olaf Bach (Scotland), Dr. Jayanta Banerjee (India), Professor Ken Boffard (South Africa), Dr. Stephen Burns (USA), Dr. Meena N. Bufalini (Italy), Dr. David Spiegel (USA), Dr. Charles Tator (Canada), Dr. Martin Weber (WHO, Geneva), Dr. Charles E. Wiles (USA), Dr. Douglas Wilkinson (England), and Dr. Tolgou Yempabe (Ghana). The following individuals participated in the Essential Trauma Care Consultation Meeting held in Geneva from June 24–26, 2002, and contributed their expertise and ideas: Dr. Charles Mock, Chair of IATSIC’s Working Group for Essential Trauma Care, based at Harborview Medical Center, Seattle, USA. Dr. Jacques Goosen, Chief of the Trauma Unit at Johannesburg Hospital, South Africa, and a member of IATSIC’s Working Group for Essential Trauma Care. Dr. Juan Asensio, Department of Surgery, Los Angeles County/USC, USA, and a member of IATSIC’s Working Group for Essential Trauma Care. Dr. Manjul Joshipura, Director of the Academy of Traumatology, Ahmedabad, India, and a member of IATSIC’s Working Group for Essential Trauma Care. Dr. Le Nhan Phuong, Hanoi School of Public Health, Vietnam. Dr. Nguyen Son, Vice-Director of Saint-Paul Hospital, Hanoi, Vietnam. Dr. Carlos Arreola-Risa, Escuela de Medicina Tec de Monterrey, Mexico. Dr. Robert Quansah, Department of Surgery, Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital, Ghana. Dr. Olive Kobusingye, Injury Control Centre, Makerere University, Uganda. Dr. Eduardo Romero Hicks, Sistema de Urgencias del Estado, Mexico. Dr. Douglas Wilkinson, Clinical Director, Nuffield Department of Anaesthesia, United Kingdom. Dr. Chris Giannou, International Committee of the Red Cross, Switzerland. Dr. Mark A. Davis, Director of the Institute for International Emergency Medicine and Health, Harvard Medical School, USA. The WHO secretariat for the consultation meeting included Dr. Etienne Krug, Director of Injuries and Violence Prevention; Ms. Kidist Bartolomeos; Dr. Raphael Bengoa; Dr. Luc de Bernis; Dr. Julian Bilous; Dr. Pierre Bwale; Dr. Meena N. Cherian; and others from WHO, Geneva.
